description: This source file implements Windows-specific DNS configuration management for Chromium, including registry monitoring, adapter address retrieval, and DNS suffix configuration.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceWin::Watcher
classes.description: Monitors registry keys and hosts file for DNS configuration changes, and manages IP address observation.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceWin::ConfigReader
classes.description: Reads DNS configuration from registry and system adapters asynchronously.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceWin::HostsReader
classes.description: Reads and updates hosts entries, including localhost and computer name.

methods.name: ParseDomainASCII
methods.description: Converts a wide string domain name to ASCII, handling IDN to Punycode conversion.

methods.name: ParseSearchList
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of domain suffixes into a vector of strings.

methods.name: ConvertSettingsToDnsConfig
methods.description: Converts Windows DNS system settings into a DnsConfig object.
